title: Five years on, US offices are still barely half full
intro: Average office occupancy as a share of pre-pandemic levels, from large-employer badge-swipe data. Occupancy climbed from 30% in 2021 but plateaued around 58%.
altInsight: US office occupancy rose from 30% of pre-pandemic levels in 2021 to 58% in 2025, but the gains slowed sharply and offices remain barely more than half full.
